systems.title: Document inference with release gates
systems.flow: page upload → durable ledger → isolated runtime → detections → frozen evaluation → release decision
systems.description: Separate runtime processes keep memory measurements interpretable. Leases and fencing prevent an expired worker from writing stale results. The memory calibration rejected its own linear fit when measured RSS contradicted the assumption.

systems.title: Evidence before generation
systems.flow: documents → source hashes → graph retrieval → frozen evidence → five perspectives → cited synthesis
systems.description: All perspectives analyze the same evidence set. Schema repair, checkpoint identity, and per-row quarantine make failures inspectable. Evidence-ID membership is recorded separately from semantic support.

systems.title: Explain a financial residual
systems.flow: exports → health gates → normalized balances → evidenced bridges → residual review → evidence packet
systems.description: Integer minor-unit money and immutable source versions support deterministic reconciliation. Reviewer decisions and audit events persist. The public demonstration uses synthetic data and keeps the ERP boundary read-only.

systems.title: Native inference under a device budget
systems.flow: model blocks → ONNX subgraphs → CPU / NNAPI → reusable buffers → timing and RSS
systems.description: The Android experiment studies native orchestration and component behavior under memory and thermal constraints. Simulated attention limits what the benchmark can say about full-model generation.
